newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica says 200,000 offers for shares.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica says 200,000 offers for shares.

text.p: The chairman of Spain's Telefonica de Espana told a local radio station on Wednesday that more than 200,000 investors had already signed up for its upcoming share offer, which opened on Monday.
He said the average size of the investment was 400,000 to 500,000 pesetas, which he recommended be long-term holdings.

"If someone wants to buy shares today in order to sell them in three weeks, I don't recommend it," said Telefonica chairman Juan Villalonga. "Telefonica is a project of continuity, future and one that offers a solid, secure and stable investment."
The subscription period for the retail tranche of the state's sale of its remaining 20.94 percent will close on February 14.
